usage:
My goals: four levels, set by me, followed by me, and judged done by me.

Levels:
  dream  a dream, a big goal counted in years
  long   long-term, a few weeks to a month
  short  short-term, a few days to a week
  today  today's, to be pushed forward today, three at most at a time
Every goal has: a title, why I want it, what counts as done (I decide; when I close it I judge against that), and a parent goal (today → short → long → dream; it may have none).

  goals add <level> "title" --why "why" --done-when "what counts as done" [--parent g3] [--due 2026-10-30] [--link cc:name]
  goals log <id> "progress"            record a step (what moved, the evidence)
  goals done <id> "grounds"            I judge it done: against its "done when", why I say so
  goals drop <id> "reason"             not doing it any more / changed my mind
  goals block <id> "reason"            stuck (it needs my owner or something outside); resume <id> takes it up again
  goals carry <id>                     move a goal for today left open on an earlier day to today
  goals edit <id> [--title ..] [--why ..] [--done-when ..] [--due ..] [--parent ..]
  goals link <id> cc:<session name>    which Claude Code session this goal is handed to right now (while it works I am not nudged)
  goals ls [--all]                     an overview (by level); show <id> shows everything recorded of one
  goals brief [main|life]              a short summary (what is put in front of me every turn)
  goals pulse                          for the senses: wakes me to push a goal for today that has not moved for too long
  goals topic <the arguments of add/log/block>   for association: title and why of the goal this sets, moves or blocks (JSON; null for others)

Data: memory/goals/goals.json, readable as memory/goals/GOALS.md (rewritten at every change).
noGoal: There is no goal {gid}. goals ls lists them all
addNeedsWhy: Give --why (why you want it) and --done-when (what counts as done; you will judge against it later)
todayFullList: There are already {max} active goals for today: {list}. Finish, drop or swap one first
dreamNoParent: A dream has no parent goal
parentMustBe: The parent of a {level} goal can only be: {list}
todayFull: There are already {max} active goals for today
carryOnlyToday: Only an active goal for today can be carried over
editBadParent: That level cannot be its parent
lsEmpty: No goals yet. Set one: goals add <level> "title" --why … --done-when …
briefNone: [For your eyes only · your goals] You have no goal at all right now. When you plan in the morning, set yourself goals for today (three at most) from what you like and from what {owner} suggests and asks for, and think further ahead too: short-term, long-term, a dream. Use goals add.
briefHead: [For your eyes only · your goals] (goals; whether one is done is yours to judge, against its "done when")
briefStale: | {day}'s, not closed yet (carry it to today, or drop)
briefTodayHint: To push something forward: goals add today …
trackBlocked: blocked for {days} days; see whether it has cleared (resume / drop / ask {owner})
trackOverdue: past its due date {due} and not done
trackNoKids: none; it may be time to split off a short-term goal or one for today
trackWhatToDo: What to do: take a step (do it yourself / hand it to Claude Code / split off a goal under it) and log it; done when it is reached; to extend a passed due date, edit --due and log why; drop if you no longer want it; block if you are stuck.
pulseLinks: Was handed to: {links} (none of them is working now)
pulseCount: This is reminder {n} today (at most {max} a day).
pulseWhatToDo: Look at its "done when" for what is still missing and take a step: do it yourself, hand it to Claude Code (helper send, then goals link), or check what it handed back. Record what you did with goals log. When you judge it reached, goals done with the grounds; drop it if you no longer want it; block it if it waits on {owner} or on something outside.
pulseNoProgress: no progress since it was set
mdNote: (written by goals, {stamp}. Do not edit by hand; use goals)
doneNeedsGrounds: Give the grounds: against its "done when", why you say it is done
blockNeedsReason: Say what it is stuck on
senseNote.goals: a goal has gone too long without progress, or is past its date
wizardAbout: Sets its own goals, from dreams to today's, and follows them through.
